scenes.label: Meet the team
scenes.title: Scores on an axis
scenes.caption: Vihaan lines up six fictional notice cards in the Decision Lab. Their supplied scores are 90, 80, 70, 60, 40 and 20. These numbers rank cases; nobody has established that they are calibrated probabilities.
scenes.speech: Vihaan lines up six fictional notice cards in the Decision Lab. Their supplied scores are 90, 80, 70, 60, 40 and 20. These numbers rank cases; nobody has established that they are calibrated probabilities.

scenes.label: The problem
scenes.title: Draw the dividing line
scenes.caption: Aditi defines positive as a notice needing specialist review. Checked positives are A, C, D and F. With threshold 70, scores at or above the line are flagged: A, B and C. Equality belongs on the flagged side.
scenes.speech: Aditi defines positive as a notice needing specialist review. Checked positives are A, C, D and F. With threshold 70, scores at or above the line are flagged: A, B and C. Equality belongs on the flagged side.

scenes.label: How it works
scenes.title: Move the boundary
scenes.caption: Lowering the threshold to 50 adds D to the review queue. Lowering it again to 30 adds E. Checked labels stay fixed, so the changing workload and mistakes come from a decision boundary moving across unchanged cards.
scenes.speech: Lowering the threshold to 50 adds D to the review queue. Lowering it again to 30 adds E. Checked labels stay fixed, so the changing workload and mistakes come from a decision boundary moving across unchanged cards.
scenes.dialogue: Move the rule, keep the cases.

scenes.label: Your decision
scenes.title: A tempting setting
scenes.caption: The team can review at most 3 cards and permits at most 1 missed positive. Choose whether any supplied threshold satisfies both conditions. Aditi refuses to describe a setting as acceptable merely because its missed-case count improves.
scenes.speech: The team can review at most 3 cards and permits at most 1 missed positive. Choose whether any supplied threshold satisfies both conditions. Aditi refuses to describe a setting as acceptable merely because its missed-case count improves.
scenes.dialogue: Do both limits fit at once?

scenes.label: What changes
scenes.title: Recount the same cards
scenes.caption: Threshold 70 needs 3 reviews and misses 2 positives. Threshold 50 needs 4 reviews and misses 1. Threshold 30 needs 5 reviews and misses 1. The lower settings reduce one miss but exceed the available review capacity.
scenes.speech: Threshold 70 needs 3 reviews and misses 2 positives. Threshold 50 needs 4 reviews and misses 1. Threshold 30 needs 5 reviews and misses 1. The lower settings reduce one miss but exceed the available review capacity.

scenes.label: Enter the lab
scenes.title: Send the plan back
scenes.caption: None of these settings meets both constraints. Vihaan records the conflict and requests a revised plan, representative evidence and a human fallback before any pilot. Tuning on this visible validation pack cannot guarantee performance on fresh unseen cases.
scenes.speech: None of these settings meets both constraints. Vihaan records the conflict and requests a revised plan, representative evidence and a human fallback before any pilot. Tuning on this visible validation pack cannot guarantee performance on fresh unseen cases.
scenes.dialogue: An honest conflict is a useful result.
